name: A Shock of Dimension
summary:
We've fallen into a parallel world after a failed experiment scattered crystals across the globe. Now we need to collect them before the villain, prevent a greater tragedy, and return home.

Join on this magical and colorful world wheres Lírio crosses valleys in search of the Crystals to prevent catastrophe and discover what caused its arrival., it will be a natural occurrence or a intentional cause?

Don't miss this Playstation 1-style journey, inspired by classics like NIGHTS Into Dreams, Ace Combat and SPYRO!
